verdict.rationale: Local user groups and meetups are a fair ecosystem question for a popular web framework, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions Next.js meetups, user groups, or an event directory. The only 'community' reference (pre-built community templates) is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.
